_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (Anthropic platform pricing page, read 2026-10-14). USD per million tokens, standard global routing, no Batch API, no fast mode.
_note: haiku_over_100k is the Haiku 5.5 rate for prompts over 100,000 tokens. The page does not say whether that rate covers the whole prompt or only the tokens above 100,000; ledger-report.py bills the whole prompt at it. Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 have no band.
